g.id: cluster_CUSTOMER-CONTROLLED DATA PLANE — on-premise; private-cloud option planned
g.text: CUSTOMER-CONTROLLED DATA PLANE — on-premise; private-cloud option planned
No documents, prompts, embeddings or tool output required.
Air-gapped sites import signed bundles manually.
Management plane cannot initiate customer task execution.
NOW = current prototype; not a production certification.
NEXT / LATER = proposed, not implemented. Amber = entirely planned component.
Mixed green components list their future extensions explicitly.
Arrows show logical interactions; this is not a network allowlist or microservice mandate.
